Sahilia

Overview

Sahilia is a thief associated with Aliya and the Last Shelter. Her disappearance leads to a rescue and a search for medicine. Once recovered, she helps the travellers with forged enlistment papers in exchange for recovering a hidden cache, opening a route into imperial service. [1, 2, 3, 4]

The ring and the brotherhood

Khatul demands an imperial signet ring from a cyclops as a test of trust. Kir brings it back and explains his intention to free his family. He also recognises that the ring does not match the description he has read. Khatul already knows it is false, but asks him to preserve the brotherhood’s belief in the trophy. Membership changes how Brother Smith receives Kir: the smith who refused a stranger now offers his craft. Through Aliya, Kir also searches for the missing Sahilia, rescues her and brings medicine. Sahilia’s recovery matters later, when her forged papers open a route into the army. [5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 1, 2, 3]

The report and the passage to Gipath

Karim’s rumour about the missing red-skinned youth becomes a document recovered from the necromancers. It records transformation and teleportation before the attack on the scholars’ mansion, with Gipath as the destination. Kir decides to follow that Joon. Sahilia supplies enlistment papers, and Kel refuses to be left behind, passing as a young man herself. Sergeant Zairak puts them through military training in Death Canyon. Their performance earns a courier assignment to the Gipath expedition. Sealed orders and a portal pass finally let them leave Suslanger under the authority of the same empire that enslaved them. [10, 11, 12, 3, 13, 14, 15, 16]
